notes: Drop 4 escalation ladder — the authored complexity/difficulty curve.
scaleWindow [lo, hi]: the compiler computes enemyScale from campaign state, then clamps into this window. The owner's difficulty dial scales the window itself.
secondaries: side objectives resolved to real zones at intent time. required=false is a bonus mark (pays reputation); required=true gates victory.
objectiveStrength: surgical (single centerpiece) | raze (the whole camp is the objective) | purge (clear the board of the enemy faction).
wavesMode: off | light | full — overrides the arc default escalation waves.
Tune here; tools/escalation_ladder_v1.py carries matching built-in defaults. Chart the result with: python tools/escalation_map_v1.py
